messages:
Riley (People Ops): Quick idea: run a 1-week 'Coffee & Kudos' pop-up in each office (May 11-15). Free coffee + physical kudos cards + a tablet for quick e-kudos. We'll pick 10 kudos for small recognition prizes and highlight on Slack. Need volunteers for shifts, barista sourcing, signage, remote kit (e-kudos cards), and budget approval. Thoughts? :coffee::sparkles:

Kai (Eng): Love it. I can cover a morning shift in SF Mon-Wed. Do we want branded cups/stickers?

Nora (Facilities): We can setup a small cart in SF lobby, NY kitchen, and LON mezzanine. Need confirmation on power access for the tablet.

Riley (People Ops): Branded sleeves would be nice but optional. Tablet can be a phone with a form if power is tight. Liam, can we borrow loaner tablets?

Liam (Office Ops): We have two spare tablets. I'll reserve one for SF and one for NY, ship one to LON. Also can arrange a folding table and small banner.

Maya (Communications): I can do a short marquee email + poster and Slack banner. Draft copy idea below. Also can create an e-kudos template for remote folks.

Diego (Finance): Budget check: estimated coffee/consumables $300, branded sleeves/stickers $120, 10 prizes at $35 = $350, shipping remote kits $80, contingency $50 => total ~$900. Please confirm cost center and approval path.

Riley (People Ops): Thanks Diego. Use recognition budget RC-2026. Can you fast-track the ~$900?

Diego (Finance): OK to approve pending a short PO. Submit expense request and tag RC-2026.

Riley (People Ops): Comms draft (first pass):

"Hey Redwood — we're popping up coffee carts May 11-15 for Coffee & Kudos Week! Stop by for a free cup and leave a quick kudos card (or tap the tablet to send an e-kudos). We'll pick 10 highlights for small prizes and Slack shoutouts. Remote folks will get e-kudos kits via email. Volunteer to host a 1-hour shift here: <signup-sheet-link>."

Kai (Eng): Text looks good. Suggest adding schedule blocks in calendar so folks can plan around it.

Maya (Communications): I'll create calendar events and a simple sign-up form. Also propose a hashtag #CoffeeAndKudos for Slack posts.

Nora (Facilities): Quick logistics note: LON requires permission to set up outside of the mezzanine on Wednesday (building event policy). I'll file the request today.

Riley (People Ops): Nice catch, Nora. Please DM any forms. Also: volunteers, reply with which office/shift you can do.

Kai (Eng): SF Mon 8:30-9:30 AM shift available from me.

Liam (Office Ops): I'll handle equipment delivery and pickup windows: setup at 7:45, teardown at 10:00 each day.

kudos-bot: Reminder: use /ekudos to log winners so Finance can reconcile spend. See /help ekudos for required fields. :robot_face:

Riley (People Ops): Remote kit plan: e-kudos email with a one-click kudos card, plus a weekly digest of top kudos. Maya, can you make the e-card and digest?

Maya (Communications): Yep, will draft e-card and a short digest template. Also can create an alternate Slack-friendly version for remote teams to post.

Diego (Finance): One small ask: capture prize redemption receipts and submit within 30 days. Also include headcount estimate for reporting. Riley, expected participants?

Riley (People Ops): Expect ~200 total interactions across offices + remote. Will put estimate in the expense request.

Nora (Facilities): Confirmed: power available at all three sites. LON permission request submitted.

Liam (Office Ops): Tablets reserved and pickup scheduled for May 10. I'm adding the setup tasks to the ops calendar.

Kai (Eng): Can we get small stickers for the cards that say 'You made my day'? I'll mock a few designs and post here.

Riley (People Ops): Love sticker idea — please post mockups. Final checklist: volunteers, PO submission (Riley), comms (Maya), equipment (Liam), facilities approvals (Nora), finance tag (Diego). Next check-in Fri 09:00 PT. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
